entry.name: Vivaldi
entry.source: https://downloads.vivaldi.com/stable/Vivaldi.8.2.4133.68.universal.dmg (the version update.vivaldi.com's mac appcast names; sha256 66c114dd721496f2b057d8d6c15e38679630e05c7a24d4ecbc5f2051235b8c60)
entry.verified: codesign --verify --deep --strict ok, spctl accepted (Notarized Developer ID, Vivaldi Technologies AS 4XF3XNRN6Y); chromedriver ad-hoc signed only (codesign ok, spctl rejects), as Chrome for Testing's
entry.notes: Copied out of the dmg (hdiutil attach -nobrowse -readonly, detached). chromedriver reports its Chromium version; the harness records Vivaldi's own (version) and the Chromium (chromium). DevTools reports Vivaldi as Chrome/8.2.4133.68 (Vivaldi's own version), so chromedriver takes it for Chrome 8 and refuses; --disable-build-check (driverArgs) skips that check. --disable-vivaldi: with Vivaldi's own UI (an extension) chromedriver finds no window (unable to discover open window: its first run opens a welcome page, and a profile seeded past that didn't help under chromedriver), so it runs with Chromium's plain UI: the pages still render in Vivaldi's own Chromium 152 build, without Vivaldi's UI layer.
